correctness.rationale: For geometric smoothness, the partial derivatives reduce to ABC and three coordinate-axis minors plus determinant of the squared-coordinate matrix; the kernel argument over an algebraic closure proves necessity and sufficiency. A rational line is a geometric bitangent iff the restricted binary quartic is proportional to the square of an F5 binary quadratic; the projective Veronese has 31 images and the discriminant separates contact types. Two complete independent integer/Groebner verifiers check all 3906 normalized coefficients and 31 lines and agree on 800 smooth equations, 15 frequencies, all seven extremizers. The finite search is provably exhaustive, not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: The space of Ciani quartics is a natural symmetry-defined genus-three moduli subfamily. Rational bitangents/odd theta-characteristics and Frobenius splitting of contact divisors are natural arithmetic invariants. A complete exact joint 15-signature classification and the sharp 16-bitangent, seven-equation locus are not determined by the old smoothness count or geometric complex 28-line arrangements, giving a useful finite-field arithmetic benchmark and explicit degeneracy pattern rather than an arbitrary slice.
